## Goal
Add static meta to DataSource/preset registry resolution for parent chains, overrides, and template/data directive pre-validation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Registry/meta can validate parent chains before docs generation with a 20-level traversal limit and cycle rejection.
- Registry/meta can resolve contribution overrides.
- Template/data directive references can be pre-validated against registered methods with a 500-reference limit per docs generation run.

## Implementation Notes
This is included in initial scope by user decision; keep behavior compatible with current DataSource classes during migration.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for meta declarations, override resolution, chain validation, directive validation, and configured limit failures.
